conventions.sign: chief minus sample optical phase at the reference sphere
conventions.sphere: center at chief detector intercept; passes through chief at paraxial exit-pupil plane
conventions.source: plane wave at infinity or spherical wave from a common finite point
conventions.piston: arithmetic mean removed over 41 equal-area source samples
conventions.tilt: optional least-squares constant + u + v; no defocus removal
conventions.wavelength: each case is monochromatic; no spectral averaging
conventions.weights: uniform source-disc quadrature; not Fresnel power or exit-pupil area
conventions.referenceApi: RayOptics trace_raw, paraxial_trace and Conic.intersect; native Hopkins API retained as diagnostic only
conventions.scope: explicit stop, coaxial isotropic spherical singlet, homogeneous output air; sampled geometric phase
